x.note: X column. Blank = first numeric column.

y.note: Y column. Blank = second numeric column.

group.note: Colour points by this category column (one legend entry per value).

label.note: Annotate each point with this column.

fit.note: Draw the OLS fit line and its R2/slope/p. Off = a plain scatter, and no fit is computed at all.

catalog.summary: Scatter plot of two continuous variables, coloured by an optional group and annotated with optional point labels — the generic x/y/hue panel. Keep the ordinary-least-squares fit line with its R²/slope/p for a 'does A track B?' figure (e.g. identity score vs developmental age, Kim 2023 Fig 4C), or turn it off for a plain scatter.
